explanation: Mathlib has no matching Laplace-PDF integrability theorem. I searched for Laplace declarations and integrability results involving exponential functions. The closest results, `integrableOn_exp_mul_Iic` and `integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi` in `Mathlib/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/ImproperIntegrals.lean`, handle separate exponential tails; the target requires splitting the piecewise PDF and combining both tails, so it is not a duplicate or a short special case of a single declaration.
